The woman, now in a pink polo shirt and black skirt, hands a bottle and a small item to another woman wearing a blue worker uniform and a face mask. (5) Back at the cafe counter, the woman in the black cap looks at a green paper cup with a male colleague wearing a black mask. She writes on the cup with a pen, and they both laugh together.
